description: Copy files from one of your apps to another, server-side: what the source is being edited to (its pre with its draft) lands in the target's draft; the users get them with neblla_promote "publish". All the source's files, or only `paths`. A path the target already has is overwritten. The target's file cap still applies (30 on free, 150 on Pro): when it is reached the copy stops and says what was left. An app linked to its own repo (neblla_git) takes them as one commit. Returns `copied` (paths), `missing` (paths whose content the source lost: upload them again) and, if any, `notCopied`.

fromAppId.description: Source app (the files are read from its pre)

message.description: A short note for the app history (neblla_versions), e.g. "Files from the old app"

paths.description: Only these paths (default: every file of the source)

name: neblla_copy_files
title: Copy files
